# Helvety Store

> Catalog pages with product specs, Store-hosted downloads (for example SPFx packages), and install links (for example the Chrome Web Store). Product prose is aligned with each app’s documentation. Hosted from Switzerland.

## Canonical URLs
- [Products catalog](https://helvety.com/store/products): Authoritative product listing (primary landing; nav CTAs use this path)
- [Store zone root](https://helvety.com/store): Redirects to the products catalog

## Product pages
The authoritative catalog is [Products](https://helvety.com/store/products); individual pages include:
- [Helvety SPO Explorer](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-spo-explorer)
- [Helvety PDF](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-pdf)
- [Helvety Image Upscaler](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-image-upscaler)
- [Helvety Image Editor](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-image-editor)
- [Helvety OCR](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-ocr): Extract text from PDFs and images in your browser on your device; scanned pages run on-device OCR and born-digital PDFs reuse their text layer; read, copy, or download plain text with no file upload to Helvety servers
- [Helvety Screen Tools](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-screen-tools)
- [Helvety Tasks](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-tasks)
- [Helvety Contacts](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-contacts)
- [Helvety Notes](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-notes)
- [Helvety Links](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-links)
- [Helvety Browser Extension](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-browser-extension): Open beta Chromium side panel for your encrypted Helvety tasks, notes, contacts, links, and folders. Sign in, unlock with a passkey, then create and edit in the panel. Manual install from GitHub releases while it is not yet in the Chrome Web Store: https://github.com/CasparRubin/helvety-browser-extension-chromium/releases
- [Power Platform Configurator](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-power-platform-configurator): Choose classic or new designer for Power Automate flow/run URLs. Control survey flags. Reveal or enable Power Apps form elements. Power Automate: choose Classic Designer, New Designer, or Paused; Hide sets v3survey=false on rewrites, while Show only normalizes an existing parameter. Power Apps: reveal hidden tabs, sections, and controls or enable disabled controls on supported model-driven record forms. Install from the Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/power-platform-configurat/mdneakhceachnimmejciaehnfjfabang

## Crawling And Indexing
- Public catalog and product pages are intended to be crawlable and indexable.
- Account routes are intended not to be indexed and are protected by authentication and noindex metadata.

## Licensing
The helvety.com monorepo is released under AGPL-3.0-or-later. Separately distributed Helvety product repositories may use different open-source licenses, including MIT, so always check the LICENSE file in the specific repository or release source link.

## Source
- [GitHub - helvety.com monorepo](https://github.com/CasparRubin/helvety): Web applications and shared packages (AGPL-3.0)
